title: What AIVideosUGC Makes for Shops | AIVideosUGC
description: AIVideosUGC turns a product photo or a product link into store images and short video ads. Shops skip the creator wait and post a file quickly.
h1: What AIVideosUGC Makes for Your Shop
lead: Shops get stuck waiting on creators, tight dates, and too many handoffs. AIVideosUGC makes store images and short video ads fast, consistent, and easy to finish.
secondary_keywords: product content tool for Etsy shops

paras: We built AIVideosUGC so you can turn a product photo into a consistent ad in minutes, without waiting on creators or handoffs.
Start with a photo, like the mug on the desk, or with the product page link. You get a square store image or a short video of 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You read the file before anyone else sees it.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a blonde chin-length bob holds a speckled mug on paper beside an open laptop.

sections.h2: Fast Enough for a Tight Week
paras: Turn one product photo and a short scene description into a listing image or video ad in minutes, without a traditional shoot.
Paste a product page when a listing changes, or test several versions from one photo to find your best ad faster. Adjust the words, the presenter, the voice, and the captions before you download.
sections.alt: Adult shop owner gets one product ready for a listing at a packing table.

sections.h2: Your Uploads Stay in Your Account
paras: Your uploads and drafts stay in your account. Other customers cannot see them.
Use photos you own or have permission to use. A request that uses a celebrity, a public figure, or a brand mark you do not own can be declined.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a copper-red low bun sits by a closed laptop and a small brass padlock.

sections.h2: High Quality Without a Heavy Bill
paras: Make polished product photos and ads without a studio bill; you see the credit cost before each job starts.

A product photo uses 24 credits. Video uses 24 credits at 6 seconds, 40 at 10, 60 at 15, or 120 at 30. A failed job returns its credits, and downloads have no watermark. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.
sections.alt: Adult seller with a short silver crop moves plain wooden tokens beside an open laptop.

sections.h2: Skip the Shoot for the Next Ad
paras: Stay off camera and still give your ad a presenter: choose an AI actor or make an AI twin from a photo you may use.

A voice you may use can be cloned, and the same ad can be made again in another language. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you want a person to look at a file. You still see the credit cost before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I make a creator-style clip of my product?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI actor, add your product, and make a creator-style video in minutes. You can change the message for your next ad.

faq.q: Can I use the same AI actor on my next ad?
faq.a: Yes. Choose the same AI actor for your next video to keep a familiar look. You can change the script, voice, or product each time.

faq.q: Can I make shop ads without booking a studio?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a product photo and make ads in minutes without booking a studio or creator. Use the finished files in your marketing.
Starter costs $24.50 for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600. A photo costs 24 credits; video credits depend on length.

faq.q: Can I post the ad on my store and on social channels?
faq.a: Yes. Download your watermark-free ad for your store, social channels, or paid campaigns. Commercial use is included.

faq.q: What can a shop make from one product photo?
faq.a: You can make listing photos, video ads, and social posts from one product image. Try new scenes and messages without another shoot.

faq.q: Can my product video include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Add a voice and captions to your product video, then review the result. Make another version in minutes if you change the message.

faq.q: What can AIVideosUGC make for my shop?
faq.a: Make product photos, product videos, and short ads from your images or product links. AI actors, voices, and scripts help you create videos without a shoot.
